rules.title: Residential rental property application fee limit
rules.quote: A landlord, or agent thereof, shall not require an application or other similar fee to apply to lease or sublease a residential rental property for dwelling purposes, which exceeds $50.
rules.summary: A landlord cannot charge more than $50 as an application fee to apply to lease or sublease a residential rental property.
rules.effective_date_evidence: This act shall take effect on the first day of the fourth month next following the date of enactment... Approved January 20, 2026.
rules.coverage_text: Does not apply to dwelling units in one-family or two-family dwellings offered for rent, or to real estate licensees (unless the licensee is the landlord).
rules.exemption_note: Exempts one-family or two-family dwellings offered for rent; exempts real estate licensees unless they are the landlord.
rules.penalty: Up to $500 for first offense, up to $750 for second offense, and up to $1,000 for each subsequent offense; wrongfully charged amount shall be remitted to applicant or prospective tenant.
